attempts.note: apis.guru mirror is a 2023 snapshot of a much smaller API

notes: Complete, verbatim copy of OpenAI's official OpenAPI 3.1 document (openai/openai-openapi openapi.yaml, API version 2.3.0): responses, chat completions, assistants, embeddings, audio, images, files, fine-tuning, batches, vector stores, realtime, containers, evals, administration, and webhooks — 288 operations, 1424 component schemas. openapi.json is the upstream YAML rendered losslessly to JSON with the x-openfn-adaptor stamp added. Replaces a 18 KiB hand-authored spec that covered only chat completions. The chatgpt adaptor's two operations (prompt, deepResearch) map to POST /chat/completions and POST /responses, both present.
